title: manageLoop
responsibility: Creates, edits, completes, reads, and renders loop state and trace; completion can enforce regression and final-task audits.

inputs.name: createLoop.input
inputs.description: Names a loop and supplies its nonblank goal; the name is validated as a loop id. Optional root defaults to process.cwd(), omitted now uses new Date().toISOString(), agentModel falls back to process.env.HARNESS_AGENT_MODEL, from resolves a source template, and kind (coding or planning) enables completion metadata with its optional plan.

examples.name: release-readiness
examples.goal: Verify that the release checklist is complete.

inputs.name: addLoopStep.input
inputs.description: Identifies an existing open loop and a new step id and title; loop and step ids are validated, and the title must be nonblank. Optional root defaults to process.cwd() and omitted now uses new Date().toISOString().

inputs.name: completeLoopStep.input
inputs.description: Identifies an open loop step and supplies nonblank evidence text; completion can be blocked by step state, enforced ordering, regression proof, or a configured final-task audit. Optional root defaults to process.cwd() and omitted now uses new Date().toISOString().

examples.evidence: Smoke checks passed on the release candidate.

inputs.name: readLoopStatus.input
inputs.description: Selects a loop by its validated name; missing files and schema-invalid state are reported as ExpectedCliError. Optional root defaults to process.cwd().

inputs.name: renderLoopStatus.status
inputs.description: Provides the loop state and relative trace path for display; the trace path is rendered verbatim and state fields drive the activity and step lines.

inputs.name: renderLoopStatus.now
inputs.description: Provides the timestamp used to calculate activity age; an invalid timestamp produces an unknown age. Defaults to new Date().toISOString().

outputs.name: createLoop
outputs.description: Resolves to the initialized loop state and repository-relative trace path after writing loop.json and appending a loop.created event. A supplied source template contributes pending steps and evaluators; without one, the new loop starts with no steps.

state.name: release-readiness
state.goal: Verify that the release checklist is complete.

outputs.name: addLoopStep
outputs.description: Resolves to the updated loop state and repository-relative trace path after appending a pending step and a step.added trace event.

state.name: release-readiness
state.goal: Verify that the release checklist is complete.

outputs.name: completeLoopStep
outputs.description: Resolves to the updated loop state and repository-relative trace path after marking the step complete with its timestamp and evidence and appending a step.completed event. Configured regression requirements and any final-task audit must pass before the state is written.

state.name: release-readiness
state.goal: Verify that the release checklist is complete.

steps.title: Run the smoke checks.
steps.evidence: Smoke checks passed on the release candidate.

outputs.name: readLoopStatus
outputs.description: Resolves to the schema-validated persisted loop state and repository-relative trace path. Missing state or schema mismatches fail rather than returning a partial status.

outputs.name: renderLoopStatus
outputs.description: Returns plain text with loop identity, goal, trace path, activity summary, and step lines. Nonempty evidence is printed as text, compact JSON for a record, or a semicolon-joined list.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Thrown for invalid loop or step names and text, missing loops, schema-invalid state, duplicate loops or steps, closed loops, step-state or enforced-order violations, invalid templates or completion kinds, and missing regression proof.

errors.name: SyntaxError
errors.description: JSON.parse throws this when persisted loop state or a project loop-template file contains malformed JSON.

errors.name: TaskCompletionService.require failure
errors.description: TaskCompletionService.require throws this when a configured final-task audit does not pass during step completion.
